premises: Hf addition to W-Ta-Cr-V yields a single-phase BCC alloy
Hf addition lowers the order-disorder transition temperature (ODTT) to ~1080 K
No precipitation is expected at temperatures near or above the ODTT
The Hf-modified alloy exhibits no dislocation loop formation and negligible volume change under irradiation
